person.name: Maksim Hrusheuski
person.bio: I’m a full-stack software engineer based in Wrocław with 8+ years of experience building and delivering web and cross-platform mobile products—from requirements and API design to production and ongoing support. I work across React/TypeScript, Node.js/NestJS, GraphQL, and mobile stacks like React Native and Flutter, with a strong focus on performance, reusable UI systems, accessibility, and spec-driven delivery.

experience.title: Mobile Application Developer — Flutter
experience.summary: Delivered a cross-platform fitness app MVP with authentication, profiles, workouts, social features, notifications, activity tracking, and QR profile sharing. Integrated REST APIs and Firebase/Auth0 OAuth and contributed reusable UI components supported by Storybook/Widgetbook.

experience.title: AI-Native Full-stack Engineer
experience.summary: Established repeatable AI-native engineering workflows using Claude Code, reusable agent skills/sub-agents, and specification-driven development. Structured delivery around requirements, code generation, automated tests, documentation, and review for a NestJS/PostgreSQL/React codebase.

experience.title: Group Manager (parallel responsibility)
experience.summary: Managed engineering delivery and team growth while continuing hands-on development. Onboarded engineers, removed access/process blockers, ran 1:1s, supported career development, prepared engineers for engineering-level assessments, and collaborated closely with product and leadership.

experience.title: AI-Augmented Mobile Applications Developer
experience.summary: Led a Cordova-to-React Native rewrite for iOS and Android using TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, GraphQL/Apollo, Zod, and Jest. Completed 260+ tasks across bug fixes, stories, and technical improvements, delivering major features like Message Center, eligibility, device settings, user logs, and multi-profile support, including configurable white-label screens and multilingual UI.

experience.title: Backend Developer
experience.summary: Designed and built a modular backend from scratch using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, GraphQL, and Apollo. Migrated the data layer from MongoDB to PostgreSQL, integrated Amazon Cognito for role-aware authentication, and Amazon S3 for media storage. Optimized data fetching with batching and pagination, enforced role-based access in resolvers, and mentored a backend developer.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
experience.summary: Built responsive Vue.js and React interfaces for MarTech and commercial clients using JavaScript/HTML5/SCSS. Integrated UI with Django-backed APIs and PostgreSQL data, maintained legacy jQuery features alongside newer React interfaces, contributed to MorphMarket/ibex.ai/Creator Traffic projects, and participated in technical interviews for hiring.

experience.title: Full Stack Engineer
experience.summary: Delivered healthcare web and AI-augmented workflows as part of a long-running engineering effort. Built and improved React/Node/TypeScript features for admin, messaging, configuration, and booking workflows. Worked with GraphQL/Apollo and MongoDB, improved table performance using cache denormalization, DataLoader batching, and pagination strategies, and refined requirements directly with stakeholders.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
experience.summary: Built React/Redux web and hybrid mobile UI for healthcare products, including Cordova applications for iOS and Android. Supported 15+ mobile apps through a shared white-label codebase, created reusable React/JSS components in Storybook, and implemented localization and WCAG accessibility improvements. Delivered tracker and to-do feature areas across multiple assignments.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
experience.summary: Built responsive websites and marketing pages using HTML5, CSS3, Pug, and SCSS. Delivered React/Redux features in a shared codebase and connected UI forms and CRUD flows to Node.js and MongoDB, contributing to a corporate website redesign.

experience.title: Web Developer (freelance)
experience.summary: Delivered freelance landing and sales pages using HTML5, SCSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. Implemented responsive layouts, interactive page elements, ensured cross-browser compatibility, and supported client handoff.

experience.title: Technical Specialist
experience.summary: Maintained an internal 1C-Bitrix portal, developed a WordPress-based alternative, and provided day-to-day IT support. Built a WordPress-based internal portal that reduced annual licensing costs by $2,513.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Intern
experience.summary: Tested desktop, web, and mobile applications; documented test cases and defects in Jira; and prepared Excel tracking reports.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
experience.summary: Performed manual testing across e-commerce, fashion, and video-streaming applications, including functional, regression, usability, and UX testing. Wrote test cases and reproducible bug reports in time to address a critical login defect.

experience.title: Document Digitizer
experience.summary: Transcribed and formatted printed educational materials in Microsoft Word, verified accuracy against source pages, and delivered ready-to-use documents.

projects.title: AerialGIS Real Estate GIS Portal
projects.role: GIS Product Developer, Designer and Engineer
summary: Client need: a single platform to visualise property data on a map and manage that data behind the scenes.
What I built: a WebGIS portal for property visualisation plus an admin panel for managing the underlying records, from ideation to launch.
My role: product development, design and engineering.
Tech: React, Mapbox, Django, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, cloud hosting.
Outcome: rated 5.0 by the client, who said the work was delivered in good time and planned to keep working with us.

projects.title: 3D Modular House Configurator
summary: Developed an interactive 3D configurator for modular house exterior customization, allowing users to personalize and visualize different exterior options in real time. The system enables selection of facade materials, colors, roof styles, windows, doors, and additional architectural elements with instant 3D updates.
Customers could explore and customize modular house

highlights.heading: Task
items: Performance optimization and integration with the website

projects.title: Testpriser - AI Hospital Finder
summary: Help us develop Sweden's first price-comparing site for healthcare services with a focus on PCR tests.

projects.title: GTPLUX - Boat Booking Platform (Multi-language)
summary: Developed complete boat booking platform for GTPLUX with multi-language support, payment processing, and comprehensive admin analytics.

highlights.heading: Core features
items: React frontend with Laravel backend API
Multi-language system (i18n) with JSON files for international markets
Real-time boat availability search with FullCalendar
Admin dashboard: sales analytics, booking management, customer database, revenue reports, retargeting tools

projects.title: Smart E-Commerce Website Modern for Security & IoT Products
summary: I designed a modern and user-friendly e-commerce website for a Smart Home & Security product brand. The website includes a clean homepage hero, category-based product browsing, featured deals, best-selling items, product cards, client testimonials, and an elegant footer. My focus was on clean layout, strong hierarchy, smooth user experience, and easy navigation to help customers explore and buy smart home devices effortlessly.

projects.title: Smart Track Booking & Management App
summary: My Tracks is a smart track booking and management app designed for racing enthusiasts, event organizers, and track owners. Users can explore tracks, book slots, manage payments, and track their booking history in one place. The app offers features like profile management, secure payments, feedback system, and privacy controls. With an easy-to-use interface, My Tracks simplifies the entire process of finding, reserving, and managing racing tracks or events, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience for all users.

projects.title: NUR – AI-Powered Islamic App (Flutter)
projects.role: Flutter Developer | UI/UX Designer | Backend Integrator
summary: NUR is a thoughtfully designed Islamic mobile app that helps users strengthen their faith through daily connection, learning, and reflection.

highlights.heading: Key Features Developed
items: Stream or read the Qur’an with audio recitations from world-renowned Qaris.
Track Salah habits and receive gentle reminders to build discipline.
Submit or read Duas from Muslims around the world.
Daily reflections, reminders, and faith-building prompts.
Integrated 7-day trial with subscription-based access afterward.

projects.title: MediGo – Online Pharmacy & Medicine Delivery
summary: MediGo is your trusted online pharmacy, designed to make healthcare simple, fast, and reliable. With just a few taps, you can search, order, and receive medicines delivered instantly to your doorstep. MediGo ensures convenience by allowing prescription uploads, secure digital payments, and subscription plans for recurring needs. Backed by verified pharmacies, real-time order tracking, and customer support, MediGo brings affordable healthcare access anytime, anywhere. Your complete pharmacy, now in your pocket.

projects.title: Restaurant Discount & Loyalty Platform (Mobile App & Website)
summary: This Restaurant Discount & Loyalty Platform is designed to make dining more affordable and rewarding. Users can explore restaurants, unlock exclusive deals, and redeem instant coupons instantly. With GPS-based offers, no hidden fees, and a smooth loyalty rewards system, the mobile app development ensures a seamless experience for Android and iOS users. Built with modern technology, it supports fast performance, secure payments, real-time notifications, and easy access via Android app development and web platforms.

summary: Client's request: an innovative solution that will allow potential buyers to visualize bathroom products such as sanitary ware and tiles in their own space, enabling them to experiment with different styles, colors, and designs in real-time

testimonials.author: Diana
testimonials.quote: Excellent work on our boat booking platform! The booking process, payment integrations, and multilingual features work smoothly. The admin dashboard makes managing reservations and tracking sales much easier. Great communication and professional delivery!

testimonials.author: Anthony
testimonials.quote: Great work on our 3D modular house configurator. The real-time customization works smoothly, and customers can easily explore different materials, colors, and design options. Professional communication and a great final result!

testimonials.author: Don Sealy
testimonials.quote: Maksim Hrusheuski delivered an outstanding WebGIS portal for our real estate platform. He handled everything from product ideation and design to full engineering — building a clean React + Mapbox frontend for property visualisation and a solid Django + PostGIS admin panel for data management. The work was completed on time, the quality was excellent, and we rated him 5.0. We fully intend to continue working with him.

testimonials.author: Jack
testimonials.quote: Maksim Hrusheuski played a key role in building Testpriser, Sweden’s first price-comparing platform for healthcare services. He translated our Figma designs into clean, responsive Next.js pages, developed solid backend APIs with Node.js and MongoDB, and smoothly integrated Google Maps and third-party services. His code was reliable, well-structured, and delivered on time. A true full-stack professional.

testimonials.author: Mathew
testimonials.quote: Maksim Hrusheuski is an outstanding React Native and Expo developer. He built our consumer habit-tracking app from the ground up with clean architecture, offline-first support, and a polished user experience. He moves fast, writes maintainable code, and always delivers production-ready features. Highly recommended.
